_comment: This is a bundled analysis-output.json form. It can be used directly without topic sidecar files.
The shape of analysis_topics[] matches the topic payload consumed by generate_report.py and the HTML template.
_classification_note: Final root-cause classification is not written here. It is the standalone artifact session-output-<timestamp>/root-cause-classification.json; see templates/root_cause_classification_example.json and references/routing/root-cause-classification-contract.md.

report.symptom: Dragging the model stalls for 1-2 seconds with visual judder and delayed head tracking.

existing_evidence.finding: Late Frames appear continuously inside the issue window in the Perfetto trace.
Triangle and Vertex counters rise together during the scene-transition window.

report.investigation_process: Tracing backward along the frame-driving thread shows resource rebuilding during the scene transition in the same window as the over-budget EngineRender stage.

root_cause_judgment.one_line: Resource rebuilding during the scene transition triggers a GPU/rendering workload peak, with the budget bound to Spatial Engine.
root_cause_judgment.reasoning: Late Frames, the over-budget rendering stage, and rendering-load counter peaks occur in the same window. GPU counters are missing, so the conclusion is likely rather than confirmed.

actions: Reduce rendering work on the drag path
Spread resource rebuilding across multiple frames
report.limitations_and_next_validation: GPU counters are missing, so concurrent GPU saturation cannot be fully excluded. Capture GPU counters or same-window simpleperf data next.
